name: Totum
source:
"TOTUM" is a non-linear visual novel. Where every choice you make will have consequences.
Try to create your ideal world, try to understand eternity and not go crazy. Or trying to get crazy. And remember the whole theater world.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2611200/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《TOTUM》是一部非线性视觉小说。你所做的每一个选择都会产生后果。
尝试创造你的理想世界，尝试理解永恒而不是疯狂。或者试图发疯。并记住整个戏剧世界。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2611200/]Steam[/url]]
